author: Zintenka
body:
Me and the Cartographers (TheHoopsman, and vsplesk) made dis map fer dah contest. I hope that it is to many people's liking ^_^

Please go to the Cartographers' official page in teams if you wish to apply.



Server provider: Alexanderjoe (Thanks, bruh.)
YML 
Download (Or go on Alex's server to see it :D)
Screenies (Updated... derp)
Features:
  • TNT
  • 6 monuments (Notice how they surround the central tree?)
  • 50v50 (100 Players)
  • 4 xp bottles and 2 firecharges for each kill
  • Mine for minerals (Iron, gold and diamond ore)
  • Cannon stations on the front
